title_zh: 约好检查松动的木质展示架

scenario.label_zh: 约好检查松动的木质展示架
scenario.goal_zh: 说明展示架的板宽与松动情况并约定先清空展示架再检查维修

context_zh: 住户向认识的家具维修人员描述一只小型木质展示架，不进行带电或机械加工操作。
author: author-phase12-c

sentences.speaker: Anya
sentences.text: Could you look at this display shelf? The timber board moves when I touch the left side.

sentences.speaker: Rob
sentences.text: What's the width of the board? I need to bring the right measuring tools.

sentences.speaker: Anya
sentences.text: Thirty centimetres. I thought you might just need to tighten the screws.

sentences.speaker: Rob
sentences.text: Perhaps, but I'll inspect it first. Please take the display pieces off before I arrive.

sentences.speaker: Anya
sentences.text: Of course. I'll clear the shelf now and leave the repair to you.
